utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps — I’ll check the list and route once you send the details, and then I can confirm what I’m bringing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Pia — I’ll send over the details as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, thanks — once I have the details, I’ll double-check the list and route so we’re all set.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, it’s really picked up—folks have been coming by steadily all afternoon. I’ll pass along anything else I hear about what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great to hear—thanks for keeping me posted! I’ll keep spreading the word and let people know they’re still welcome to come by.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely—every extra pair of hands helps, and I’ll let you know if I hear about any gaps they still need filled.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details—what do you still need help with at the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We still need a few more volunteers to match people with repairs, and someone to help keep the sign-up list updated. I can start reaching out and keep the list current too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I can help with the sign-up list if that makes things easier. Just let me know where to be and when.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Vik — thanks for keeping it organized and low-key.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: You got it — I’ll mention it there and keep everyone on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I haven’t confirmed the repair-drive details yet, so let me check them first before we contact the coordinator.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — just send me the details when you’ve got them, and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll check the details and send them over once I’ve confirmed everything.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That would be a huge help, Kira—could you help spread the word or keep track of volunteers?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? So the repair drive is actually getting a decent turnout?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s looking that way, yes—now I just need help keeping it organized and making sure we’ve got enough volunteers in each spot.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: After lunch works for me, Sam — just let me know where the repair drive is and I’ll make a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — it’s at the community center on Maple, and I’ll meet you there after lunch to help with the list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Perfect, Sam — the community center on Maple after lunch works for me. I’ll bring a simple list and we’ll get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning still sounds good to me—I’ll double-check the school calendar and make sure it doesn’t conflict with anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye. Let me know what you find, and I’ll wait before contacting the coordinator.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Will do — I’ll check the calendar and get back to you as soon as I can.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Opal — after lunch I’ll stop by and we can make the repair list together.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good — after lunch works for me, and I’ll keep an eye out for the repair drive location in the meantime.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, thanks, Opal — I’ll see you after lunch, and if you spot the repair drive location, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — appreciate you keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m still sorting the list, but hammers, extra screws, and maybe a second extension cord would help most right now.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Cleo — that helps a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for hammers, screws, and a second extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be a huge help, Mara—thank you. If you spot any spare drill bits or work gloves too, I can add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can bring my drill and socket set tomorrow, Leo. Just let me know if you need anything else for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus — please bring the drill and socket set tomorrow. I’ll check the porch steps and see if we need any other tools.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good, Leo — I’ll bring both tomorrow and I’m happy to grab anything else if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll bring it up at the repair drive and make sure everyone knows the plan.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’d be a huge help, Vik—thank you. If you can also keep an eye out for anyone who’s unsure where to jump in, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep an eye out and point folks in the right direction if they’re unsure. I’ll make sure the plan stays clear at the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — after lunch we’ll make the list and keep it straightforward.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps — once you’ve got the list and timing set, please send me the route and parking details too. I’ll be able to confirm after I check those.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sure — after lunch I’ll make the list, then send you the route and parking details once I’ve got them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, Nell, but I need to keep it quiet and take it one small step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’s totally fine — small steps work for me too. Just let me know what part you want to start with, and I’ll follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Nell. I’ll start with one small thing and let you know quietly as I go.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good, Kira — after lunch I’ll swing by and we can check the repair drive together.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks — can you confirm the list and the route one more time when you swing by? I’ll feel better once that’s settled.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing — after lunch I’ll stop by, and we’ll confirm the list and the route together.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — I’ll start with the porch steps and check what materials we need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds like a good place to start—let me know if you need any basic tools or spare parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rey — I’ll let you know if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Late Saturday morning still sounds best to me. I can keep reaching out for volunteers and update the sign-up list once we’re set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’m out running errands, and I’ll pass along any repair drive updates I hear.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — I appreciate it. I’ll keep the list moving and let everyone know once we have a few more volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Mara — just let me know what you need for the repair drive, and I’ll bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Gus — what we still need most is a few more volunteers and someone to help keep the sign-up list updated. If you can bring either of those, that would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely — I can help with the sign-up list and I’ll ask around for a few more volunteers too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We still need a couple of hammers, some extra screws, and maybe that second extension cord if I can spare one.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll check on the hammers and screws. Do you want me to ask the coordinator about the extension cord too?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Yes, please ask about the extension cord too — that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still checking around for the repair drive location, Tess — I’ll let you know as soon as I hear where it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Opal — I appreciate you checking around. I’ll keep passing along anything I hear about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sounds good, Tess — I’ll keep an eye out and pass along the location as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks for the reminder. I’d probably miss the update if you didn’t keep everyone posted.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Happy to keep everyone in the loop — it’s this Saturday at the community center, and there’s parking right behind the building. If you can make it, come by and bring a friend!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Quinn — I’ll try to make it. I’m glad you mentioned the parking, too; I probably would’ve overlooked that.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help sort the donations and load the boxes this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Late Saturday morning still works for me, and I’ll double-check the school calendar to make sure there’s no conflict.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, thanks for checking — I’ll be there Saturday morning to help sort and load the boxes.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — I’m still glad to keep it simple and quiet, one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Dane — I’ll check the repair-drive details first, then we can decide the next step.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sounds good, Hana — just let me know what you find, and I’ll go from there.
